import pandas as pd,numpy as np,statsmodels.formula.api as smf
w=pd.read_parquet('works.parquet')
w['late']=(w.year>=1876).astype(int);w['r']=w['count__domains__DISTANCE_TRAVEL']/w.n_passages
w['ap']=w.groupby('author_key').work_id.transform('count')
print(w.year.describe()); print(w.decade.value_counts().sort_index())
def est(d):
  g=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.mean().unstack(); return (g[1]-g[0]).mean()
print('est',est(w))
rng=np.random.default_rng(0);bs=[]
for i in range(1000):
  bs.append(est(w.groupby(['genre','late'],group_keys=False).apply(lambda x:x.sample(len(x),replace=True,random_state=rng.integers(1e9)))))
print(np.percentile(bs,[2.5,97.5]))
for c in ['date_confidence','origin']:
  for v,d in w.groupby(c): print(c,v,round(est(d),4))
print('high',est(w[w.date_confidence=='high']))
m=smf.ols('r~late+C(genre)+C(origin)+C(date_confidence)+n_editions+np.log(ap)',w).fit(cov_type='cluster',cov_kwds={'groups':pd.factorize(w.author_key)[0]})
print(m.params['late'],m.conf_int().loc['late'].values)
m=smf.ols('r~year+C(genre)',w[w.date_confidence=='high']).fit();print(m.params['year'],m.pvalues['year'])
print(w.groupby('decade').r.mean().round(3))
for c in ['n_editions','ap']: print(c, np.corrcoef(w.year,w[c])[0,1])

m=smf.ols('r~year+C(genre)',w[w.date_confidence=='high']).fit();print(m.params['year'],m.pvalues['year'])
